bio.text: Quantá Crews is a Democratic member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 26; the Arizona Legislature's member page lists the position of House Minority Whip.

According to the 2024 candidate-submitted voter guide, Crews is a property appraiser and associate minister at Historic Tanner Chapel A.M.E. Church in Phoenix, and was appointed to the Arizona House in June 2023.

sources.title: Voter Education Guide, 2024 primary: Legislative District 26 (candidate-submitted statements)
